_readme: URL -> { date, title, filePath } recorded the first time that URL was ever emitted into a WXR file. WordPress recognizes an already-imported page by matching its TITLE AND its DATE together (see "How WordPress decides..." in tools/wxr/README.md), and it keeps both even after a human later publishes the imported Draft by hand — so this file is what makes a page's title+date pair both believable on the live site AND permanently stable no matter how many more times it gets regenerated, or how much later. generate.js appends one new entry automatically (via --date) the first time a URL needs one; it never rewrites an entry that already exists — if the current H1 for a URL no longer matches the recorded title, generate.js stops with an error instead of guessing which one is right (silently picking either one reopens the exact duplicate-page bug this file exists to prevent). "filePath" is only used to notice when a URL itself has been renamed in content/ (the same file now defines a different URL) — see "A page's URL changing" in tools/wxr/README.md. Commit this file whenever generate.js reports it added new entries. To correct a mistake before anything has actually been imported into WordPress, it is safe to hand-edit an entry directly — it is plain JSON.
